prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a **local small business**, I’d start with **BrightLocal’s Local AI Visibility Tracker**. It’s designed to check whether ChatGPT and Google’s AI search features recommend a specific business location, and lets you compare your visibility with local competitors. Its site lists plans starting at **$31/month**; the tracker is included in its local SEO plans, with up to 20 prompts per location.

If you want a cheaper, broader-purpose tracker rather than a local-SEO tool, **Otterly.AI** is another option; reported entry pricing is around **$25/month** and it tracks prompts across several AI engines. For a free, one-time baseline, try **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**.

One caveat: AI answers vary by wording, location, and time, so no tracker can give a definitive yes/no. Test prompts real customers might ask—such as “best [service] near [town]”—and treat results as a trend, not a guarantee.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
